hooks.name: Review the landing interactions and handoff

action.prompt: Review the saved file and related implementation against the Kiro requirements, design, steering, and README. Invitation: confirm that the module and fallback nightometers agree, normalize progress to the footer entry point, and reach 60 there with no valid fields; confirm narrow-screen signup bottom spacing. Confirm that only valid invitation submissions count; attempts one and two show distinct messages with escalating shakes and unlock the form afterward; attempt three saves session details, plays the strongest shake together with the restrained pixel-tear glitch, fades to black, and calls beginTheOtherSide() on the same page without navigating away. Other side: confirm the canvas title sequence starts with the arrival music autoplay attempt and the icon-only sound toggle, keeps pace with the music when the tab is hidden, holds the full title indefinitely, then shows the message and Go deeper; Skip intro fades into the end of the pull-back; reduced motion shows the final frame. Confirm Go deeper plays the glitch and strongest shake, turns the title sequence over, hides the sound toggle, and starts the Underside, with gentle mode only through reduced motion. Confirm www/escape.html plays its local WebM/MP4 title video and continues to ./index.html?descend on ended, skip, error, rejected autoplay, or reduced motion. Underside: confirm flashes and jumpscares go through createFlashLimiter and createScareGate, and that gentle mode has no jumpscares, hammer, or gore. Stack: confirm only the approved runtime libraries are used (local GSAP, vendored three.js, Lenis and the optional Spline runtime from pinned unpkg URLs, Capacitor as the native wrapper) and that no UI framework, CSS utility library, or bundler was added. For Capacitor changes, confirm www/ is the single editable web source, capacitor.config.json points at it, the root app files have not been duplicated, and sync commands copy it into android/ and ios/ before launch. Report concrete mismatches only. Do not edit files or run tests automatically.
